name: Welcome Back Hamilton 2026

venue.name: The Hardy Centre
venue.address: Hardy Guide Centre 18 Hungerford Crescent, Hamilton East, Hamilton 3216

information:
Hamilton Open 2026 is an official World Cubing Association (WCA) competition. Events include 3x3x3 (Main Event), 2x2x2, 4x4x4, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock and Pyraminx. This will be the first WCA competition located in Hamilton in over 3 years. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
